verdict.rationale: BILL documents a public REST v3 API that covers Spend & Expense: budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions and reimbursements. The developer docs add an API reference with in-page testing, a Postman collection, a sandbox, S&E recipes and AI-agent aids (llms.txt, confirmed live by probe, plus a docs MCP server). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of S&E API usage, and detailed S&E endpoint-level documentation in the pack (most endpoint examples are AP-focused).
